page.layout: One printed page (left page, page 138) with running head at top, main text in full width, a table of figures in the middle, and a catchword-like heading "CAPVT" at lower right. Right side shows the adjacent page edge with a marginal note "I. Alligationis" set vertically in the right margin of the neighbouring page (outside this page's text block).

main_text.p: Sic tertij 235 aureos multiplica per 9, fiunt 2115, item 45 in 7, fiunt 315, quæ prioribus addita, faciunt 2430. Quod si porrò compositis istis terminis (quem admodum antea uisum) procedas, proportio concludetur, quàm hîc unà cum totius exempli digestione adiectam cernis:
main_text.l: Sors. Mefes. Copositi primo p multiplicat. Compositi additione. Totum
main_text.head: CAPVT

page.notes: The table's left column of Roman-style numerals (1, II, III) and the bracket/brace marks are printed as shown. Alligationis" belongs to the facing right-hand page and is not part of this page's text. Some faint show-through from the reverse side is present and omitted.
